$comment: Frozen oracle for SCN-DSN-003. The limit and the counting rule are fixed here; the count is computed by the runner from the rendered DOM. No audit file written during the phase is read.
countRules: count only elements that are visible (non-zero box, not display:none, not inside a collapsed Advanced region)
count inside the section's main panel only; exclude the navigation, header, breadcrumb and banner
buttons (Save, Reload, Test, links) are not counted
sectionsChecked: every section in fixtures/settings-routes.json with a namespace form; sections that render a full page (providers, models, credentials, tools, mcp-health, skills, compiler, memory-records, access-keys, budget) are checked for the same limit on their first screen

keyboard: hidden controls become visible in DOM order

negativeControl: a scratch console served with one section forced to render 9 visible controls must fail the counter naming that section
